readout_other: single-unit spike rate and extracellular action potential waveform (32-channel silicon probe)
direction_notes: Spike rate increased at 500 Hz PRF (200 us PD) and with longer PD at 50 Hz PRF (800 us largest); 50 us PD gave a non-significant decrease; V1 and holding-bar controls showed smaller or no change.

exposures.label: Motor cortex PRF and PD sweeps (plus V1 and holding-bar controls)

target.label: rat motor cortex (AP 0.48 mm, ML 3.5 mm)

timing.protocol_description: 500 ms pulse trains once per second for a 3-min stimulation epoch, with 3-min pre and post epochs; PRF 25, 50, 500, 2000 Hz at fixed 200 us PD, and PD 50 to 800 us at fixed 50 Hz PRF; controls used 500 Hz and 800 us over V1 or the electrode holding bar.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty-six male Sprague–Dawley rats (250–400 g; Charles River Laboratories) were used.
